description: A resizable blank panel showing a fixed image or an animated GIF, loaded from disk, dropped onto the module, or run as a slideshow.
notes: nothing is shown until an image is loaded, either through Load image on the menu or by dropping a PNG, JPEG, BMP or GIF file onto the module.
drag either side edge of the module to make it wider or narrower.
with the mouse over the module, A, S, D and W move the image, Z and X zoom it, and Q and E rotate it by a quarter turn.
with the mouse over the module, J and L step one frame back and forward, K goes to the first frame and I to a random frame.
with the mouse over the module, P turns the animation on and off, M turns the slideshow on and off, and the two square bracket keys load the previous and next file in the directory.
menu: Load image (PNG, JPEG, BMP, GIF) — opens a file chooser, and the path of the file in use is printed under it.
Image Scaling — Fit Both (stretch both directions), Fit Width, Fit Height or Free.
Animation Enabled — turns GIF playback on or off.
Animation Options — holds Animation Mode, set to Forward, Reverse, Ping Pong, Random Shuffled or Full Random, a Constant Frame Delay toggle, and an Animation Speed slider.
Slideshow Enabled — loads another file from the current image's directory over and over.
Slideshow Options — holds the next-file order, Shuffle Seed, Slideshow Time, a Crossfade Enabled toggle and Crossfade Time.
Keyboard Controls — lists the shortcuts, and carries the Invert Y-Axis toggle that reverses which way the image moves.
Dim Visuals with Room — makes the image follow Rack's room brightness; turned off, the image stays fully opaque as the lights go down.
Hide panel — removes the blank panel art that is drawn when no image is loaded.
